title: Circuits
description: Adds a computer, a server rack, monitors also a keyboard and mouse.
body:
This mod adds computers to play around with for fun; they don't actually work yet, but they might work in a different update

1.0.4 Adds wide and tall monitors, keyboard and mouse
1.0.3 Changes the textures of the monitor and the computer
1.0.2 Adds Server Racks and Server Shelves.
1.0.1 Adds crafting recipes, 256GB Ram, 1TB Memory and changed the GUI.
1.0.0 Is the first version, and adds graphics cards, motherboards, RAM, memory, and CPUs.

I will try to add more. 
A list of everything in this mod.
- Gpus
- Motherboards
- Cpus
- Ram (2GB, 32GB, 128GB, 256GB)
- Memory (64GB, 256GB, 512GB, 1TB)
- Computer Case
- Monitor
- Crafting recipe for all items
- Server Rack
- Server Shelf
- Wide Monitor
- Tall Monitor
- Keyboard
- Mouse
